step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents an automated ad creation workflow architecture for Advanced Local. Salesforce (SFDC) initiates the flow via a trigger into an API Gateway ('Creative API'). Behind API Gateway, three Lambda functions ('Parsing', 'Routing', and 'Workflow') handle parsing incoming data, routing configuration, and managing the workflow. Parsed data is written to the 'Ad Data' DynamoDB table via a long curved arrow from the Parsing Lambda. Routing logic interacts with the 'Config' DynamoDB table. On the right side, an ad creation client application (represented by a mobile/tablet device icon) reads from the 'Ad Data' DynamoDB table, receives static assets from S3, and invokes the 'Workflow' Lambda. Amazon Cognito fronts user authentication.
